name: Gib Baltzer
source:
A former police officer who is on the run as a suspect in the murder of a colleague.
As a member of the special forces during his time as a police officer, he was a sniper who excelled at handling firearms. 

Always calm and collected, he fills the role of leader in the group. 
He can make decisions from an objective point of view, but due to his serious personality, he often can't relate to younger people.

He was married once but is now a widower.

Hometown: Rothenburg ob der Tauber [Germany]
